'''Rodrygo Silva de Goes''' ({{IPA|pt-BR|ʁoˈdɾiɡu ˈsiwvɐ dʒi ˈɡɔjs|lang}};<ref>{{Cite web |last=Team |first=Forvo |title=Rodrygo Goes pronunciation: How to pronounce Rodrygo Goes in Portuguese |url=https://forvo.com/word/rodrygo_goes/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190328203310/https://forvo.com/word/rodrygo_goes/ |archive-date=28 March 2019 |access-date=11 May 2025 |website=Forvo.com |language=en}}</ref> born 9 January 2001), better known as '''Rodrygo''', is a Brazilian professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays primarily as a [[Winger (association football)|winger]] for {{Spanish football updater|Real Madrid}} club [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] and the [[Brazil national football team|Brazil national team]].

Rodrygo began his career with [[Santos FC|Santos]], where he played 80 games and scored 17 goals before a €45&nbsp;million transfer to Real Madrid in 2019. Over the following seasons, he established himself as a prominent member in Real Madrid's squad, helping the club win two La Liga–[[UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] doubles in [[2022 UEFA Champions League final|2022]] and [[2024 UEFA Champions League final|2024]].

After representing Brazil at youth level, Rodrygo made his senior debut in 2019, aged only 18, representing Brazil at the [[2022 FIFA World Cup]] in Qatar and the [[2024 Copa América]] in the United States.

==Club career==
===Santos===
[[File:RodrygoGoes.jpg|thumb|left|Rodrygo playing for [[Santos FC|Santos]] in 2018|262x262px]]
Born in [[Osasco]] in [[São Paulo (state)|São Paulo]], Rodrygo joined [[Santos FC|Santos]]' youth setup in 2011 at the age of ten, initially assigned to the [[futsal]] team.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://globoesporte.globo.com/sp/santos-e-regiao/futebol/times/santos/noticia/2016/08/inspiracao-em-neymar-e-pai-jogador-conheca-rodrygo-nova-joia-do-santos.html|title=Inspiração em Neymar e pai jogador: conheça Rodrygo, nova joia do Santos|trans-title=Inspiration in Neymar and father footballer: know Rodrygo, new pearl of Santos|publisher=[[Globo Esporte]]|language=pt|date=16 August 2016|access-date=2 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190416101445/http://globoesporte.globo.com/sp/santos-e-regiao/futebol/times/santos/noticia/2016/08/inspiracao-em-neymar-e-pai-jogador-conheca-rodrygo-nova-joia-do-santos.html|archive-date=16 April 2019|url-status=live}}</ref> Rodrygo travelled the world with Santos, spreading his beloved game of futsal under legendary futsal coach Barata who also trained Neymar, including a much heralded YouTube video with City Futsal in Dallas area in Texas, USA. In March 2017, with the first team regulars in Peru for a [[Copa Libertadores]] match against [[Sporting Cristal]], he was called up to the first team by manager [[Dorival Júnior]] to complete training.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.lance.com.br/santos/promessa-rodrygo-ganha-chance-aproxima-profissional.html|title=Na mira europeia, jogador de 16 anos faz treinos no profissional do Santos|trans-title=In the European sight, 16-year-old player does training at Santos' first team|publisher=[[Lance!]]|language=pt|date=10 March 2017|access-date=2 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190416101447/https://www.lance.com.br/santos/promessa-rodrygo-ganha-chance-aproxima-profissional.html|archive-date=16 April 2019|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 21 July 2017, Rodrygo signed his first professional contract, after agreeing to a five-year deal.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.santosfc.com.br/rodrygo-revelacao-da-base-assina-o-primeiro-contrato-profissional-com-o-santos-fc/|title=Rodrygo, revelação da base, assina o primeiro contrato profissional com o Santos FC|trans-title=Rodrygo, youth prospect, signs the first professional contract with Santos FC|publisher=Santos FC|language=pt|date=21 July 2017|access-date=2 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190327183806/https://www.santosfc.com.br/rodrygo-revelacao-da-base-assina-o-primeiro-contrato-profissional-com-o-santos-fc/|archive-date=27 March 2019|url-status=live}}</ref> On 1 November, he was promoted to the main squad by interim manager [[Elano]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://espn.uol.com.br/noticia/739868_elano-anuncia-promocao-de-rodrygo-e-yuri-alberto-ao-time-profissional-do-santos|title=Elano anuncia promoção de Rodrygo e Yuri Alberto ao time profissional do Santos|trans-title=Elano announces promotion of Rodrygo and Yuri Alberto to the first team of Santos|publisher=[[ESPN Brasil]]|language=pt|date=1 November 2017|access-date=2 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171117122544/http://espn.uol.com.br/noticia/739868_elano-anuncia-promocao-de-rodrygo-e-yuri-alberto-ao-time-profissional-do-santos|archive-date=17 November 2017|url-status=live}}</ref> 

Rodrygo made his first team – and [[Campeonato Brasileiro Série A|Série A]] – debut on 4 November 2017, coming on as a late [[Substitute (association football)|substitute]] for [[Bruno Henrique Pinto|Bruno Henrique]] in a 3–1 home win against [[Clube Atlético Mineiro|Atlético Mineiro]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://globoesporte.globo.com/sp/santos-e-regiao/futebol/brasileirao-serie-a/jogo/04-11-2017/santos-atletico-mg/|title=Santos sofre, mas vence Atlético-MG de Robinho e fica a três pontos do líder|trans-title=Santos suffer, but defeat Robinho's Atlético-MG and stay three points behind the leader|publisher=Globo Esporte|language=pt|date=4 November 2017|access-date=4 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190327161620/http://globoesporte.globo.com/sp/santos-e-regiao/futebol/brasileirao-serie-a/jogo/04-11-2017/santos-atletico-mg/|archive-date=27 March 2019|url-status=live}}</ref> The following 25 January he scored his first senior goal, netting a [[Last-minute goal|last-minute winner]] in a 2–1 [[Campeonato Paulista]] away win against [[Associação Atlética Ponte Preta|Ponte Preta]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://esporte.uol.com.br/futebol/campeonatos/paulista/ultimas-noticias/2018/01/25/sasha-e-nova-joia-do-santos-viram-o-jogo-e-dao-vitoria-contra-a-ponte.htm|title=Sasha e 'nova promessa' do Santos viram o jogo e dão vitória contra a Ponte|trans-title=Sasha and "new prospect" of Santos complete comeback and give victory against Ponte|publisher=[[Universo Online|UOL Esporte]]|language=pt|date=25 January 2018|access-date=26 January 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190416101441/https://esporte.uol.com.br/futebol/campeonatos/paulista/ultimas-noticias/2018/01/25/sasha-e-nova-joia-do-santos-viram-o-jogo-e-dao-vitoria-contra-a-ponte.htm|archive-date=16 April 2019|url-status=live}}</ref>

Rodrygo made his [[Copa Libertadores]] debut on 1 March 2018, replacing [[Eduardo Sasha]] in a 2–0 away loss against [[Real Garcilaso]]; aged 17 years and 50 days, he became the youngest player of Santos to appear in the competition.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gazetaesportiva.com/times/santos/rodrygo-e-o-mais-novo-jogar-libertadores-na-historia-do-santos/|title=Rodrygo é o mais novo a jogar Libertadores na história do Santos|trans-title=Rodrygo is the newest to play Libertadores in Santos' history|publisher=Gazeta Esportiva|language=pt|date=1 March 2018|access-date=1 March 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190416101443/https://www.gazetaesportiva.com/times/santos/rodrygo-e-o-mais-novo-jogar-libertadores-na-historia-do-santos/|archive-date=16 April 2019|url-status=live}}</ref> Fifteen days later he scored his first goal in the tournament, netting his team's second through an individual effort in a 3–1 win against [[Club Nacional de Football|Nacional]] at the [[Pacaembu Stadium]]; at the age of 17 years, two months and six days, he became the youngest Brazilian to score in the competition<ref>{{cite web|url=https://globoesporte.globo.com/sp/santos-e-regiao/futebol/times/santos/noticia/em-post-sobre-rodrygo-santos-exalta-sua-tradicao-em-revelar-jovens-talentos.ghtml|title=Em post sobre Rodrygo, Santos exalta sua tradição em revelar jovens talentos|trans-title=In post about Rodrygo, Santos lift up their tradition of uncover young talents|publisher=Globo Esporte|language=pt|date=16 March 2018|access-date=16 March 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191208144606/https://globoesporte.globo.com/sp/santos-e-regiao/futebol/times/santos/noticia/em-post-sobre-rodrygo-santos-exalta-sua-tradicao-em-revelar-jovens-talentos.ghtml|archive-date=8 December 2019|url-status=live}}</ref> before his record was broken by fellow Santos youth graduates [[Kaiky Fernandes|Kaiky]] and [[Ângelo Gabriel|Ângelo]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://globoesporte.globo.com/sp/santos-e-regiao/futebol/times/santos/noticia/noticias-santos-angelo-mais-novo-gol-libertadores.ghtml|title=Ângelo, do Santos, faz história e se torna jogador mais novo a fazer um gol na Libertadores|trans-title=Ângelo, from Santos, makes history and becomes the youngest to score a goal in the Libertadores|publisher=GloboEsporte.com|language=pt-BR|date=6 April 2021|accessdate=7 April 2021}}</ref> 

Rodrygo scored his first goal in the main category of Brazilian football on 14 April 2018, netting the last in a 2–0 home win against [[Ceará Sporting Club|Ceará]].<ref>{{cite web |url= https://globoesporte.globo.com/sp/santos-e-regiao/futebol/brasileirao-serie-a/jogo/14-04-2018/santos-ceara.ghtml |title= Santos bate Ceará e volta a vencer em estreia de Brasileirão depois de 13 anos |trans-title= Santos defeat Ceará and is back to winning in debut after 13 years |publisher= Globo Esporte |language= pt |date= 14 April 2018 |access-date= 15 April 2018 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20180416013035/https://globoesporte.globo.com/sp/santos-e-regiao/futebol/brasileirao-serie-a/jogo/14-04-2018/santos-ceara.ghtml |archive-date= 16 April 2018 |url-status= live }}</ref> On 3 June, he scored a [[hat-trick]] and also [[Assist (association football)|assisted]] [[Gabriel Barbosa|Gabriel]]'s last goal in a 5–2 home routing of [[Esporte Clube Vitória|Vitória]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://esporte.uol.com.br/futebol/campeonatos/brasileiro/serie-a/ultimas-noticias/2018/06/03/santos-x-vitoria.htm|title=Com show de Rodrygo, Santos goleia o Vitória na Vila e dá fôlego a Jair|trans-title=With a show from Rodrygo, Santos thrash Vitória at the Vila and give air to Jair|publisher=UOL Esporte|language=pt|date=3 June 2018|access-date=4 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180612144046/https://esporte.uol.com.br/futebol/campeonatos/brasileiro/serie-a/ultimas-noticias/2018/06/03/santos-x-vitoria.htm|archive-date=12 June 2018|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 26 July 2018, Rodrygo changed his jersey number from 43 to 9 (a number he already wore during the Libertadores).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gazetaesportiva.com/times/santos/rodrygo-recebe-surpresa-e-e-oficialmente-o-novo-camisa-9-do-santos/|title=Rodrygo recebe surpresa e é, oficialmente, o novo camisa 9 do Santos|trans-title=Rodrygo receives surprise and is, officially, the new number 9 of Santos|publisher=Gazeta Esportiva|language=pt|date=26 July 2018|access-date=26 July 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191208144524/https://www.gazetaesportiva.com/times/santos/rodrygo-recebe-surpresa-e-e-oficialmente-o-novo-camisa-9-do-santos/|archive-date=8 December 2019|url-status=live}}</ref> For the 2019 campaign, he again switched numbers, now to jersey 11, previously worn by fellow youth graduate [[Neymar]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://esporte.uol.com.br/futebol/campeonatos/copa-sul-americana/ultimas-noticias/2019/02/12/lista-da-sul-americana-revela-que-rodrygo-abandona-camisa-9-e-assume-a-11.htm|title=Lista da Sul-Americana revela que Rodrygo abandona camisa 9 e assume a 11|trans-title=Sudamericana list reveals that Rodrygo leaves number 9 and takes 11|publisher=UOL Esporte|language=pt-BR|date=12 February 2019|access-date=19 March 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190717140953/https://esporte.uol.com.br/futebol/campeonatos/copa-sul-americana/ultimas-noticias/2019/02/12/lista-da-sul-americana-revela-que-rodrygo-abandona-camisa-9-e-assume-a-11.htm|archive-date=17 July 2019|url-status=live}}</ref>

===Real Madrid===
On 15 June 2018, [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] reached an agreement with Santos for the transfer of Rodrygo, with the player joining ''Los Blancos'' in June 2019 and signing until 2025.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2018/06/official-announcement-rodrygo-goes|title=Official Announcement: Rodrygo Goes|publisher=Real Madrid C.F.|date=15 June 2018|access-date=15 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190328101649/https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2018/06/official-announcement-rodrygo-goes|archive-date=28 March 2019|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.santosfc.com.br/nota-oficial-3/|title=Nota oficial|trans-title=Official announcement|publisher=Santos FC|language=pt|date=15 June 2018|access-date=15 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180709164515/https://www.santosfc.com.br/nota-oficial-3/|archive-date=9 July 2018|url-status=live}}</ref> The rumoured fee was of [[Euro|€]]45&nbsp;million,<ref>{{Cite web |date=15 June 2018 |title=Real Madrid transfer news: €45 million deal agreed for Santos wonderkid Rodrygo |url=https://www.goal.com/en-ng/news/real-madrid-agree-45m-deal-for-santos-wonderkid-rodrygo/1q0uvjdo7i5yr1cw4frmubp3i4 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191107122304/https://www.goal.com/en-ng/news/real-madrid-agree-45m-deal-for-santos-wonderkid-rodrygo/1q0uvjdo7i5yr1cw4frmubp3i4 |archive-date=7 November 2019 |access-date=11 May 2025 |website=www.goal.com |language=en-NG}}</ref> with Santos receiving €40&nbsp;million as the club owned 80% of his rights with the rest owned by Rodrygo's agents.<ref>{{cite web|author1=Sport |url=https://www.sport-english.com/en/news/real-madrid/santos-striker-rodrygo-signs-for-real-madrid-until-2025-6878340|title=Santos striker Rodrygo signs for Real Madrid until 2025|work=[[Sport (Spanish newspaper)|Sport]]|date=15 June 2018|access-date=15 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180615163236/https://www.sport-english.com/en/news/real-madrid/santos-striker-rodrygo-signs-for-real-madrid-until-2025-6878340|archive-date=15 June 2018|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 25 September 2019, Rodrygo made his first team debut and scored his first league goal against [[CA Osasuna|Osasuna]] within a mere minute.<ref>{{Cite web |date=25 September 2019 |title=Rodrygo becomes Real Madrid's first 21st century scorer |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2019/09/25/5d8be1efca474112558b45a4.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191001200012/https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2019/09/25/5d8be1efca474112558b45a4.html |archive-date=1 October 2019 |access-date=11 May 2025 |website=MARCA in English |language=en}}</ref> He scored his first hat-trick, and gave an assist for the club on 6 November, aged 18 years and 301 days old, against [[Galatasaray S.K. (football)|Galatasaray]] in a 6–0 win in the [[2019–20 UEFA Champions League]] season.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.goal.com/en-us/news/rodrygo-makes-champions-league-history-with-quickfire-madrid/s41v7oj8qzl1pv50ot9f40bt|title=Rodrygo makes Champions League history with quickfire Real Madrid double|website=Goal.com|date=6 November 2019|access-date=6 November 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191106222217/https://www.goal.com/en-us/news/rodrygo-makes-champions-league-history-with-quickfire-madrid/s41v7oj8qzl1pv50ot9f40bt|archive-date=6 November 2019|url-status=live}}</ref> The second youngest ever to score a hat-trick in the competition, he is also the first player born in the 21st century to score in the tournament.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://en.as.com/en/2019/11/06/football/1573071750_168543.html|title=Rodrygo scores perfect hat-trick in Real Madrid UCL rout|website=as.com|date=6 November 2019|access-date=6 November 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191110132213/https://en.as.com/en/2019/11/06/football/1573071750_168543.html|archive-date=10 November 2019|url-status=live}}</ref> In his first season, he managed to make 19 appearances, while scoring two goals during the league season, as Real Madrid won the [[2019–20 La Liga]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2020/07/17/5f10db2146163f3c2c8b45d7.html|title=Real Madrid win the longest LaLiga Santander season|date=17 July 2020|access-date=17 July 2020|website=Marca|location=Spain}}</ref> On 3 November 2020, Rodrygo scored the winning goal in a 3–2 victory over [[Inter Milan]] in the [[2020–21 UEFA Champions League]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Begley |first=Emlyn |date=3 November 2020 |title=Real Madrid 3–2 Inter Milan |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/54784152 |website=BBC Sport|access-date=25 March 2026}}</ref>

On 12 April 2022, after coming on as a substitute in the second leg of the [[2021–22 UEFA Champions League]] quarter-final tie against [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]], he scored with a volleyed finish to send the game into extra-time, in which [[Karim Benzema]] scored the winner from a header, allowing Real Madrid to progress into the semi-finals.<ref>{{cite web |last=Johnston |first=Neil |date=12 April 2022 |title=Real Madrid 3–2 Chelsea |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/61067661 |website=BBC Sport|access-date=25 March 2026}}</ref> On 30 April, Rodrygo helped Real clinch their [[2021-22 La Liga|35th La Liga title]] after scoring twice in a 4–0 win against [[RCD Espanyol|Espanyol]] at the [[Santiago Bernabéu Stadium|Bernabéu]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/61284264 |title=Real Madrid 4–0 Espanyol |website=BBC Sport |date=30 April 2022 }}</ref> On 4 May, while trailing 0–1 (3–5 on aggregate) in the second leg of the Champions League semi-final tie against [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]], he scored two goals between the 90th and 91st minutes to level the tie and send the game into extra-time. Benzema scored a penalty to win the game 3–1, allowing Real Madrid to progress into the [[2022 UEFA Champions League Final|final]] against [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool]] with an aggregate score of 6–5 and eventually win the tournament.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Hytner |first=David |date=4 May 2022 |title=Real Madrid in final after Rodrygo and Karim Benzema stun Manchester City |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2022/may/04/real-madrid-manchester-city-champions-league-semi-final-second-leg-match-report |access-date=11 May 2025 |work=The Guardian |language=en-GB |issn=0261-3077}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2022/06/03/la-decimocuarta/amp|title=La Decimocuarta! |website=Real Madrid C.F. – Web Oficial|date=7 June 2022 }}</ref> Following the turnaround win against City and other recent last-minute winning contributions, Rodrygo’s impact on the team was praised despite his young age and he quickly turned into a cult hero at Madrid.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Law |first=Joshua |date=5 May 2022 |title=Rodrygo is the silent assassin who drips with Madrid's terrible purpose |url=https://www.planetfootball.com/trending/rodrygo-real-madrid-champions-league-man-city-goals-semi-final-assassin |access-date=11 May 2025 |website=Planet Football |language=en}}</ref>

On 18 April 2023, he scored a brace in a 2–0 away victory over Chelsea in the [[2022–23 UEFA Champions League]] quarter-final second leg, which secured his team's qualification to the semi-finals by winning 4–0 on aggregate.<ref>{{cite web |last=Wright |first=Nick |url=https://www.skysports.com/football/chelsea-vs-real-madrid/report/481694 |title=Chelsea 0–2 Real Madrid (agg 0–4): Rodrygo scores twice as Blues outclassed by holders in Champions League quarter-final |publisher=Sky Sports |date=18 April 2023 |access-date=25 March 2026}}</ref> On 6 May, he scored two goals for Real Madrid in a 2–1 win over [[CA Osasuna|Osasuna]] in the [[2023 Copa del Rey final]], to be their 20th title in that competition.<ref>{{Cite web |date=6 May 2023 |title=Rodrygo stars as Real Madrid win the Copa del Rey against spirited Osasuna |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/copa-rey/cronica/2023/05/07/6456ce98ca4741bb6c8b45d5.html |access-date=11 May 2025 |website=MARCA |language=en}}</ref> 

On 2 November 2023, Real Madrid announced that Rodrygo's contract had been extended, with a new expiration date of 30 June 2028.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2 November 2023 |title=Official Announcement: Rodrygo signs extension until 2028 |url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2023/11/02/official-announcement-rodrygo-signs-extension-until-2028 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231126070705/https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2023/11/02/official-announcement-rodrygo-signs-extension-until-2028 |archive-date=26 November 2023 |access-date=2 November 2023 |website= |publisher=Real Madrid CF |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2 November 2023 |title=Rodrygo renews his Real Madrid contract until 2028 |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2023/11/02/6543a55b268e3edf218b459b.html |access-date=2 November 2023 |website= |publisher=MARCA |language=en}}</ref>

On 2 March 2026, he suffered a [[Anterior cruciate ligament injury|torn ACL]] during a 1–0 home defeat against [[Getafe CF|Getafe]], requiring surgery and an extended recovery period, effectively ruling him out from [[2026 FIFA World Cup|World Cup 2026]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=3 March 2025|title=The Storm Continues at Real Madrid! Rodrygo Tears ACL and Says Goodbye to the Season… and the World Cup|url=https://www.beinsports.com/en-us/soccer/la-liga/articles/the-storm-continues-at-real-madrid-rodrygo-tears-acl-and-says-goodbye-to-the-season-and-the-world-cup-2026-03-03|access-date=3 March 2026|website=beinsports.com}}</ref>

==International career==
On 30 March 2017, Rodrygo was called up to [[Brazil national under-17 football team|Brazil under-17s]] for the year's [[Montaigu Tournament]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://selecao.cbf.com.br/noticias/selecao-base-masculina/selecao-sub-17-convocada-para-torneio-de-montaigu|title=Seleção Sub-17 convocada para Torneio de Montaigu|work=Seleção Brasileira |trans-title=Under-17 national team called up for the Montaigu Tournament|publisher=[[Confederação Brasileira de Futebol|CBF]]|language=pt|date=30 March 2017|access-date=2 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180326141447/https://selecao.cbf.com.br/noticias/selecao-base-masculina/selecao-sub-17-convocada-para-torneio-de-montaigu#.WfqSpVtSzDc|archive-date=26 March 2018|url-status=live}}</ref> He made his debut in the championship by scoring his side's only goal in a 2–1 loss against [[Denmark national under-17 football team|Denmark]], and netted two more against [[Cameroon national under-17 football team|Cameroon]] and [[United States men's national under-17 soccer team|United States]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.lance.com.br/santos/oito-gols-quatro-jogos-quarteto-peixe-destaca-selecao-sub.html|title=Oito gols em quatro jogos: quarteto do Peixe se destaca na Seleção sub-17|trans-title=Eight goals in four matches: ''Peixe's'' quartet is a spotlight at ''Seleção'' under-17|publisher=Lance!|language=pt|date=17 April 2017|access-date=2 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191208145501/https://www.lance.com.br/santos/oito-gols-quatro-jogos-quarteto-peixe-destaca-selecao-sub.html|archive-date=8 December 2019|url-status=live}}</ref> 

On 7 March 2018, Rodrygo and Santos teammate [[Yuri Alberto]] were called up to the [[Brazil national under-20 football team|under-20]]s,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://globoesporte.globo.com/futebol/selecao-brasileira/noticia/rodrygo-e-yuri-alberto-do-santos-substituem-joias-do-flamengo-na-selecao-sub-20.ghtml|title=Rodrygo e Yuri Alberto, do Santos, substituem joias do Flamengo na seleção sub-20|trans-title=Rodrygo and Yuri Alberto, from Santos, replace Flamengo's pearls in the national under-20 team|publisher=Globo Esporte|language=pt|date=7 March 2018|access-date=11 May 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191107044044/https://globoesporte.globo.com/futebol/selecao-brasileira/noticia/rodrygo-e-yuri-alberto-do-santos-substituem-joias-do-flamengo-na-selecao-sub-20.ghtml|archive-date=7 November 2019|url-status=live}}</ref> but both were cut from the squad six days later after a request from his club's president.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.lance.com.br/santos/apos-ida-peres-rio-cbf-libera-rodrygo-yuri-alberto-selecao.html|title=Após ida de Peres ao Rio, CBF libera Rodrygo e Yuri Alberto da seleção|trans-title=After Peres' trip to Rio, CBF release Rodrygo and Yuri Alberto from the national team|publisher=Lance!|language=pt|date=13 March 2018|access-date=11 May 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191107044047/https://www.lance.com.br/santos/apos-ida-peres-rio-cbf-libera-rodrygo-yuri-alberto-selecao.html|archive-date=7 November 2019|url-status=live}}</ref> 

In November 2019, Rodrygo was called up for the first time to the [[Brazil national football team|Brazil senior team]], for the [[Superclásico de las Américas]] against rivals [[Argentina national football team|Argentina]] in [[Riyadh]], Saudi Arabia.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Munday |first1=Billy |title=Rodrygo gears up for his Brazil bow against Argentina |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2019/11/11/5dc9c70d268e3e4e3e8b4647.html |access-date=15 November 2019 |work=Marca|location=Spain |date=11 November 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191115234104/https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2019/11/11/5dc9c70d268e3e4e3e8b4647.html |archive-date=15 November 2019 |url-status=live }}</ref> In the [[2019 Superclásico de las Américas|1–0 loss]] on 15 November, he replaced [[Willian (footballer, born 1988)|Willian]] for the final 20 minutes.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Train |first1=Rob |title=Real Madrid: Rodrygo makes full debut for Brazil against Argentina |url=https://en.as.com/en/2019/11/15/football/1573844470_031298.html |access-date=15 November 2019 |work=Diario AS |date=15 November 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191129010722/https://en.as.com/en/2019/11/15/football/1573844470_031298.html |archive-date=29 November 2019 |url-status=live }}</ref> 

On 7 November 2022, Rodrygo was named in the squad for the [[2022 FIFA World Cup]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Seleção Brasileira está convocada para a Copa do Mundo FIFA Qatar 2022|url=https://www.cbf.com.br/selecao-brasileira/noticias/selecao-masculina/selecao-brasileira-esta-convocada-para-a-copa-do-mundo-fifa-qatar-2022|publisher=[[Brazilian Football Confederation|CBF]]|access-date=7 November 2022|date=7 November 2022|language=pt}}</ref> On 9 December, Brazil faced [[Croatia national football team|Croatia]] in the quarter-finals of the World Cup. With the match ending in a 1–1 draw after extra time, the tie would be decided on penalties. Rodrygo took Brazil's first penalty, but his kick was saved by Croatia goalkeeper [[Dominik Livaković]]. Brazil were eliminated after [[Marquinhos]]' shot hit the post.<ref>{{cite web |last=Hafez |first=Shamoon |title=World Cup 2022: Croatia 1-1 Brazil (4-2 pens): Tite's men knocked out |url= https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/63830320 |publisher=BBC Sport |access-date=26 February 2025|date=9 December 2022|language=pt}}</ref> 

In May 2024, Rodrygo was selected for Brazil’s squad for the Copa América.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.goal.com/en-us/lists/brazil-copa-america-2024-squad-dorival-junior/blt3c3e8b96dd3771ab |title=Brazil Copa America 2024 Squad: Dorival Junior's Selections |website=Goal |access-date=11 December 2024}}</ref>

In March 2026, Rodrygo was expected to be part of Brazil’s squad for the 2026 FIFA World Cup but was ruled out after suffering a torn anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) and lateral meniscus injury in his right knee during a La Liga match for Real Madrid against Getafe. The injury required surgery and sidelined him for several months, ending his 2025–26 season and forcing him to miss the tournament.<ref>{{cite news |title=‘Life has been cruel’: Rodrygo opens up on heartbreak as Real Madrid star accepts World Cup dream is over with massive injury blow |url=https://www.foxsports.com/stories/soccer/life-has-been-cruel-rodrygo-opens-up-on-heartbreak-as-real-madrid-star-accepts-world-cup-dream-is-over-with-massive-injury-blow
 |work=Fox Sports |date=3 March 2026 |access-date=4 March 2026}}</ref>

==Style of play==
Considered to be a talented and highly promising young player in the media, Rodrygo's playing style has been likened to that of compatriots and fellow Santos FC graduates [[Robinho]] and [[Neymar]] due to their pace, technical skill, and similar direct style in attack. Although he does not possess significant physical strength or athleticism, due to his diminutive stature, Rodrygo's low centre of gravity, combined with his [[Dribbling#Association football|dribbling]] skills and resulting agility, allow him to change direction quickly when in possession of the ball, and beat opponents in one on one situations. He has also been noted for his decision-making, offensive positioning, finishing, link-up play, and creativity, which allows him to hold-up the ball and create space or chances for his teammates, in addition to scoring goals himself. He has also been praised by pundits for his work-rate and willingness to press opponents. While he normally plays as a right-winger, he is a versatile player, who has been used in several other positions, including on the left, and was also used in a free role as a right-sided forward or [[Forward (association football)#Striker|striker]] in a 4–3–1–2 formation during the 2023–24 season by manager [[Carlo Ancelotti]]; in this position, although he operated in more central areas at times, he was still given the freedom to move out wide to overload the flanks, or switch positions and link-up with Vinícius on the other side of the pitch. Although he is naturally right-footed, Rodrygo does not normally play as an inverted winger on the opposite flank, in contrast to many other wingers of his era.<ref name="best wingers2">{{Cite web |date=11 November 2022 |title=The 25 best right wingers in world football – ranked |url=https://www.90min.com/posts/the-25-best-right-wingers-in-world-football-ranked |access-date=9 April 2024 |website=90min.com |language=en-GB}}</ref><ref name="best wingers3">{{Cite web |last1=McCambridge |first1=Ed |last2=Hancock |first2=Tom |date=14 April 2023 |title=Ranked! The 10 best right-wingers in the world right now |url=https://www.fourfourtwo.com/features/ranked-the-best-right-wingers-in-the-world-right-now |access-date=16 April 2024 |website= |publisher=FourFourTwo |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/opinion/2019/10/23/5db01c3de2704ee7498b4598.html |title=Rodrygo and Vinicius, so similar yet so different |work=MARCA |date=23 October 2019 |access-date=2 June 2024 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://breakingthelines.com/data-analysis/rodrygo-what-makes-him-one-of-the-hottest-prospects-in-world-football/ |title=Rodrygo: What Makes Him One of the Hottest Prospects in World Football? |publisher=Breaking The Lines |date=16 May 2023 |access-date=2 June 2024 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en-US/news/football/first-team/latest-news/nacho-vini-jr-and-rodrygo-are-pure-magic |title=Nacho: 'Vini Jr. and Rodrygo are pure magic' |publisher=Real Madrid CF |language=es |date=11 November 2023 |access-date=2 June 2024 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=15 October 2023 |title=Rodrygo sends message to Ancelotti: I don't like playing as a No.9 but I have to at Real Madrid |url=https://e01-marca.uecdn.es/en/football/real-madrid/2023/10/15/652bf568268e3ef3768b4577.html |access-date=25 March 2026 |website=MARCA |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11095/13144511/carlo-ancelotti-s-real-madrid-success-is-triumph-of-man-management-but-a-tactical-idea-too-in-his-own-way |title=Carlo Ancelotti's Real Madrid success is triumph of man-management but a tactical idea, too, in its own way |work=Sky Sports |last1=Bate |first1=Adam |language=en |date=29 May 2024 |access-date=30 May 2024 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Graham |first=Hunter |date=22 August 2023 |title=Vinicius Júnior's frustration is a dilemma for Real Madrid |url=https://www.espn.co.uk/football/story/_/id/38234460/vinicius-junior-frustration-dilemma-real-madrid |access-date=25 March 2026 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Español |first=En |date=20 April 2019 |title=Five Brazilian football experts explain what makes Rodrygo so special |url=https://e01-marca.uecdn.es/en/football/real-madrid/2019/04/20/5cba0fc2ca474129128b45d5.html |access-date=25 March 2026 |website=MARCA in English |language=en}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Rodrygo is a [[Christians|Christian]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=25 December 2023 |title=Rodrygo Goes Spreads Festive Joy and Reflects on Meaningful Christmas |url=https://www.inkl.com/news/rodrygo-goes-spreads-festive-joy-and-reflects-on-meaningful-christmas |access-date=25 March 2026 |website=inkl |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Rodrygo Goes Official Instagram |url=https://www.instagram.com/p/C1QkrhosAdf/?hl=en&img_index=1 |access-date=25 March 2026 |website=www.instagram.com}}</ref>

Rodrygo and Brazilian beautician Pamella Cristina Costa welcomed twin sons in February 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Córdoba |first=Adrián |date=23 December 2022 |title=Real Madrid’s Rodrygo surprises fans with images of his twin sons |url=https://en.as.com/soccer/real-madrids-rodrygo-surprises-fans-with-images-of-his-twin-sons-n/ |access-date=25 March 2026 |website=AS USA |language=en-us}}</ref> His father, [[Eric Batista de Goes|Eric]], is a former professional footballer who played as a [[right-back]] in several tiers of Brazilian football, the highest of which being the [[Campeonato Brasileiro Série B|Série B]].<ref>{{Cite news |title=Filho de Eric se destaca na base do Santos e é chamado de Neymarzinho |trans-title=Eric's son is a spotlight at Santos' youth setup and is called 'Little Neymar' |url=http://globoesporte.globo.com/ce/futebol/times/ceara/noticia/2013/02/filho-de-eric-se-destaca-na-base-do-santos-e-e-chamado-de-neymarzinho.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191107044048/http://globoesporte.globo.com/ce/futebol/times/ceara/noticia/2013/02/filho-de-eric-se-destaca-na-base-do-santos-e-e-chamado-de-neymarzinho.html |archive-date=7 November 2019 |access-date=25 March 2026 |work=globoesporte.com}}</ref> 

In February 2024, Rodrygo partnered with the Juegaterapia Foundation and artist Titocustoms to launch a fundraising campaign against childhood cancer. The initiative, part of the "Everything is going to be fine" campaign, involved auctioning personalized items—including [[Nike, Inc.|Nike]] sneakers, a jacket, a ball, and a painting—to support affected children.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Rodrygo launches a new campaign to raise funds against childhood cancer |url=https://www.madridistanews.com/en/news/detail/rodrygo-launches-a-new-campaign-to-raise-funds-against-childhood-cancer |access-date=25 March 2026 |website=Madridista |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Córdoba |first=Adrián |date=23 December 2022 |title=chuyensanco |url=https://chuyensanco.com |access-date=25 March 2026 |website=chuyensanco.com |language=en-us}}</ref> Rodrygo’s father had already made the prediction that he was going to be a footballer before he was even born. He has one younger sister, Ana Julya, who was born in 2018.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Meet Rodrygo's Footballer Father, Mother, Twin Kids: All About Real Madrid Star's Family Life |url=https://www.essentiallysports.com/soccer-football-news-meet-rodrygos-footballer-father-mother-twin-kids-all-about-real-madrid-stars-family-life/ |access-date=25 March 2026 |website=Essentially Sports}}</ref>

==Honours==
